entries.title: PipeKit and pre-existing materials IP assignment
entries.summary: AtliQ assigns all Intellectual Property Rights in the Deliverables, including proprietary tools (like PipeKit) and pre-existing materials incorporated therein, absolutely to Northwind Logistics upon payment of Milestone fees.
entries.quote: All Intellectual Property Rights in the Deliverables, including any software, tools, frameworks, libraries and pre-existing materials incorporated into the Deliverables, shall vest in the Client absolutely upon payment of the Charges for the relevant Milestone. The Supplier hereby assigns to the Client, with full title guarantee and by way of present assignment of future rights, all such Intellectual Property Rights with effect from such payment.

assets: pre-existing tools and libraries incorporated in Deliverables

relatedClauses.quote: "Deliverables" means all work product, software, code, pipelines, configurations, documentation and other materials created, supplied or delivered by the Supplier to the Client in the course of the Services.

The Supplier will build the pipeline using its proprietary pipeline accelerator, PipeKit, which provides pre-built ingestion connectors, orchestration templates, data-quality checks and monitoring components. PipeKit will be configured and extended for the Client and incorporated into the delivered pipeline as its ingestion and orchestration layer.

entries.notes: Because SOW-1 incorporates AtliQ's proprietary pipeline accelerator (PipeKit) directly into the delivered pipeline, and clause 9.2 assigns all IPR in pre-existing materials incorporated into the Deliverables, AtliQ is effectively assigning the IP rights of PipeKit to Northwind. There is no background IP license or carve-out.

entries.title: Mutual staff non-solicit
entries.summary: Both parties are prohibited from soliciting any employee of the other party engaged in the Services during the term of the agreement and for six months thereafter.
entries.quote: Neither party shall, during the term and for six (6) months afterwards, solicit any employee of the other party engaged in the Services.
entries.notes: Routine mutual non-solicit restricted to personnel engaged in the Services and limited to 6 months post-termination.

entries.title: Subcontracting and Assignment Restriction
entries.summary: AtliQ may not assign or subcontract any of its rights or obligations under the agreement without the Client's prior written consent.
entries.quote: The Supplier shall not assign or subcontract any of its rights or obligations without the Client's prior written consent.
entries.notes: Requires prior written consent from Northwind for any subcontracting of Services.

entries.title: Source code delivery
entries.summary: AtliQ must deliver the source code for all software Deliverables to Northwind's nominated repository upon completion of each Milestone.
entries.quote: The Supplier shall deliver the source code for all software Deliverables to the Client's nominated repository on completion of each Milestone.

relatedClauses.quote: (b) Production pipeline (incorporating PipeKit) for WMS, telematics and TMS sources;

entries.notes: Delivering source code incorporating PipeKit's core proprietary orchestration and templates represents a high intellectual property risk because there is no background license protecting AtliQ's underlying proprietary assets.
